rv.q: The overall effect is something like a dream: all mood, little drama.
Musically lush, stripped-back new revival proves more stately than spellbinding

Seeing the garden rediscovered in a retelling this musically accomplished is always going to be a delight and The Secret Garden—The Musical is a family-friendly night out that children and adults are sure to enjoy.
The Secret Garden – The Musical is performed beautifully by an incredibly talented company, but some of the creative choices don't do the material full justice.
The Secret Garden, The Musical , even with its flaws, is a beautiful piece of theatre that kept me enthralled from start to finish.

cn.t: John Doyle's atmospheric revival brings haunting depth to the beloved musical, emphasizing ghosts and adult secrets over the garden itself. Critics find the Yorkshire-set production fresh and fitting, though responses remain moderately positive overall.
